title: Session Length Analysis
scenario: Calculate the duration of each session (time diff between start and end).
tableSchema: sessions (user_id INT, action_time TIMESTAMP, action_type VARCHAR)
hint: Use LEAD() to find the next action timestamp.
correctQuery: SELECT user_id, (LEAD(action_time) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY action_time) - action_time) AS duration FROM sessions WHERE action_type = 'start';
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sessions (user_id INT, action_time TIMESTAMP, action_type VARCHAR);
